ModMetaData.name: Mech Muster
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Give each mechanitor a wanted count of every mech type and let new mechs sort themselves out.
- Set wanted counts per mechanitor - Newly available unassigned mechs go to whoever has a deficit - Respects bandwidth, priorities, and any assignment you made yourself - Colony-wide overview when you have several mechanitors - Automation can be switched off globally or per mechanitor
Requires Biotech, Harmony, and Spine.
